resourceBudgets.rationale: Top-level bundled resources must stay below an intentional pre-sign budget aligned to the current avatar catalogs so app size regressions remain visible before archive.
resourceBudgets.evidence: Current local size is reported by release hardening; CI fails if the budget is exceeded.

Require a valid Ohana/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy before release hardening can pass.
Keep the Xcode build phase that strips bundle extended attributes before CodeSign.
